The '''Drong system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Steniplis sector/Legends|Steniplis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drong II]].
